title: BiasFix: adjusting assessment marks for assessor leniency
description: BiasFix is a free R Shiny application and R function that adjusts marks from rater-based assessments (for example viva voce examinations and OSCEs) for assessor leniency by placing each assessor's marks on the scale of the whole cohort (mean-sigma linear equating). The repository also contains the analysis code for the accompanying article in Anatomical Sciences Education.
